verdict.rationale: Bento documents subscriber import (bulk create/update, tags, custom fields via API) and explicitly offers 'migration help when you switch' plus community testimonials of switching from Mailchimp/Hubspot, but there is no documented guided import wizard or explicit statement that unsubscribe state is preserved during migration. missing for 10: a dedicated guided migration wizard/tool description, explicit documentation that unsubscribe status is preserved on import, and independent evidence of successful list-preserving migrations.
